structured_data.title: John Wick: Chapter 4
structured_data.description: John Wick uncovers a path to defeating The High Table. But before he can earn his freedom, Wick must face off against a new enemy with powerful alliances across the globe and forces that turn old friends into foes.
structured_data.writer: Shay Hatten, Michael Finch, Derek Kolstad
